source.citation: Hayt et al. (2018). Engineering Circuit Analysis, 9th ed., Ch.7 — first-order RC step response. t_rise(10-90%) = R·C·ln(9) ≈ 2.197τ.

sim_completed.description: 1 if LTspice transient ran without errors, else 0

vout_settled.description: Steady-state V(out) — cap fully charged to source
vout_settled.T_good_source: Ideal cap charges to source: 1.0 V exactly. T_good 2% covers averaging-window precision.

t_rise.T_good_source: Closed-form t_r = R·C·ln(9) = 1k·100n·ln(9) ≈ 219.72 µs. Oracle on wine LTspice 26 measures 219.72 µs (matches closed-form exactly). T_good 9% covers transient time-step granularity (.tran step 100 ns).
